source_model: Kerr-axis selects tetrahedral vertex; oriented C3 source sector

lensing_dataset.primary: Planck PR4 NPIPE minimum-variance lensing reconstruction, PR3-like public map product

multipole_band.reason: Planck lensing science range begins at L=8; upper bound keeps the test on large angular scales while providing multiple independent m sectors

axis_score.S_C3: unweighted mean of centered per-L fractions for L=8..30
axis_score.axis_search: maximize S_C3 over an unoriented SO(3) axis; azimuth about axis is irrelevant to the m mod 3 projector

cross_observable_alignment.primary_null: Planck PR4 lensing simulations processed through the identical axis search if available
cross_observable_alignment.fallback_geometric_null: for an unbiased random unoriented axis, P(Delta<=d)=1-cos(d)

required_variants: TT-only reconstruction if supplied in the same release
polarization-only reconstruction if supplied in the same release

interpretation.PASS_candidate: a stable lensing C3 axis aligns with the frozen temperature axis beyond the preregistered null expectation
interpretation.FAIL: no stable C3 axis or no cross-observable alignment

forbidden: change L range after inspecting lensing alms
change modulo class from 3 after inspection
use a different lensing estimator only because it aligns better
treat a lensing-axis alignment as proof of a Kerr cosmological parent
